name.en: New York State Route 28 — the Central Adirondack Trail
name.zh: 纽约 28 号州道（阿迪朗达克中部小径）

tagline.en: A C-shaped route from the Catskills round to the Hudson
tagline.zh: 自卡茨基尔绕行至哈德逊河的 C 形路线

en: NY 28 is shaped like the letter C. It starts at Kingston on the Hudson, runs west and north-west up the Esopus valley into the Catskills through Boiceville, Phoenicia and Shandaken, continues across the Delaware headwaters to Oneonta, turns north through Cooperstown and Richfield Springs to Herkimer on the Mohawk, and then goes north-east across the Adirondacks to finish at Warrensburg — back on the Hudson, about seventy miles north of where it started.

The Catskill end and the Adirondack end are the reasons the route exists as a single number: it is the road that links New York's two great forest preserves. Between them it is a Mohawk Valley and dairy-country highway that happens to pass the Baseball Hall of Fame.

In the Adirondacks it runs through the less crowded western and central part of the park — Old Forge, the Fulton Chain of Lakes, Inlet, Raquette Lake, Blue Mountain Lake, Indian Lake, North Creek — rather than the High Peaks. From North Creek south it follows the Hudson.
zh: NY 28 的形状像字母 C。它自哈德逊河畔的金斯敦起步，向西北沿伊索普斯河谷进入卡茨基尔，经博伊斯维尔、腓尼基与尚达肯，再越过特拉华河源头抵达奥尼昂塔，随后北转经库珀斯敦与里奇菲尔德斯普林斯到达莫霍克河畔的赫基默，最后向东北穿越阿迪朗达克，终于沃伦斯堡——重回哈德逊河畔，距起点以北约七十英里。
卡茨基尔一端与阿迪朗达克一端，正是这条路线得以共用一个编号的理由：它是连接纽约州两大森林保护区的道路。两者之间，它是一条莫霍克河谷与乳业地带的公路，顺带经过棒球名人堂。
在阿迪朗达克境内，它穿行的是公园里人少的西部与中部——老福吉、富尔顿湖链、因莱特、拉凯特湖、蓝山湖、印第安湖、北溪——而非高峰区。自北溪往南，它沿着哈德逊河而行。

en: NY 28 dates from 1924, in the first round of New York state route numbering, but its present shape came out of the 1930 renumbering, when the route was extended south into Kingston and north into the Adirondacks.

The northern extension is what produced the C. From Wevertown the route was carried south-east to Warrensburg along its present alignment, which means the last thirty miles run in the opposite direction to the route's overall trend — the reason travellers on NY 28 in the Adirondacks are frequently heading south while following signs that say north.
Cooperstown remains the one place where the state does not maintain the road: NYSDOT maintains all of NY 28 except the portion within the village.
zh: NY 28 始于 1924 年，属纽约州道编号的第一轮，但其今日的形状出自 1930 年的重新编号——当时路线向南延伸进入金斯敦，向北延伸进入阿迪朗达克。
北段延伸造就了那个 C 字。自韦弗敦起，路线沿今日线位向东南通至沃伦斯堡，这意味着最后三十英里与整条路线的总体走向相反——这正是为什么在阿迪朗达克境内行驶 NY 28 的人常常一边朝南开，一边看着写有「北」的标志。
库珀斯敦仍是该州不负责养护的唯一一处：除村内路段外，纽约州交通部养护 NY 28 全线。

en: The Adirondack portion is a designated state scenic byway. NYSDOT lists the Central Adirondack Trail as 140 miles connecting Glens Falls and Rome, with scenic, recreational, natural and historic intrinsic qualities.

What the department promises is accurate and modest: camping, skiing, picnicking and canoeing, regional museums and historic sites, and the option of combining the drive with a lake cruise or a scenic train ride. The Adirondack Museum at Blue Mountain Lake and the railway at North Creek are both on or beside the route.

The Catskill end is a different drive and a shorter one — Kingston to Margaretville through the Esopus and East Branch valleys — but it runs through the Catskill Park with the same character of narrow valleys, state land and small mountain villages. Neither end has a seasonal closure; both have winter conditions that decide how fast you actually go.
zh: 阿迪朗达克段是一条指定的州级风景道。纽约州交通部将「阿迪朗达克中部小径」列为连接格伦斯福尔斯与罗马的 140 英里路线，具备风景、游憩、自然与历史四项内在特质。
该部门的承诺准确而克制：露营、滑雪、野餐与划艇，地区博物馆与历史遗址，以及把驾车与湖上巡游或观光列车结合起来的可能。蓝山湖的阿迪朗达克博物馆与北溪的铁路都在路线之上或之侧。
卡茨基尔一端是另一趟、也更短的旅程——自金斯敦经伊索普斯与东支河谷至玛格丽特维尔——但它穿过卡茨基尔公园，同样有狭窄河谷、州有土地与山间小村的气质。两端都没有季节性封闭；两端都有决定你实际车速的冬季路况。

value.en: 140 miles, connecting Glens Falls and Rome
value.zh: 140 英里，连接格伦斯福尔斯与罗马

figures.source: NYSDOT Scenic Byways, Central Adirondack Trail

why.en: NYSDOT publishes highway mileage by jurisdiction and county rather than by touring route, and no state-published total for NY 28 could be verified this session.
why.zh: 纽约州交通部按管辖主体与县发布公路里程，而非按巡游路线；本次未能查证到该州公布的 NY 28 总里程。

timeline.en: NY 28 is designated in the first round of New York state route numbering.
timeline.zh: NY 28 在纽约州道编号的第一轮中划定。

timeline.en: The renumbering extends the route south into Kingston and north into the Adirondacks, giving it its present C shape.
timeline.zh: 重新编号将路线向南延伸至金斯敦、向北延伸进入阿迪朗达克，形成今日的 C 形。
